transcript:
Meeting header: 2026-02-18 15:00 PST | Duration: ~54 mins | Attendees: Maya T. (Redwood AE), Liam P. (Redwood SE), Sara G. (Brightdale), Tom L. (SRE), Priya N. (PM)

Summary: Hosted API demo showing embeddings + rerank flow for search relevance. Covered console, APIs, example code, and Optimize recs.

[00:00] Maya: Hey everyone, thanks for joining. I'm Maya from Redwood, AE, and with me is Liam our solutions engineer.
[00:10] Sara: Good thanks, excited to see how you can help our search.
[00:15] Liam: Agenda: demo embeddings endpoint, rerank endpoint, Console + Optimize, Q&A.
[00:30] Priya: Goals: better relevance for patient-facing search, sub-second latency, reasonable cost, compliance fit.
[00:45] Maya: Quick qual: what are you running today?
[00:52] Sara: Elastic Cloud 7.12, custom BM25 tweaks, small ML for synonyms. Latency 700-1200 ms.
[01:10] Liam: Pattern: combine vector similarity + lexical recall, then rerank with cross-encoder or learned reranker. We'll demo embeddings POST /v1/embeddings and rerank POST /v1/rerank.
[01:35] Tom: How integrate with Elastic without ripping and replacing?
[01:42] Liam: Keep ES for recall, call Redwood to embed docs and queries, use rerank for final scoring. Store dense vectors in ES or external vector DB.
[02:05] Maya: Links shared in follow-up.
[02:25] Sara: Show the API flow.
[02:30] Liam: (Console) Hosted API keys panel, embeddings endpoint example in Python and curl. Demo sends batch of 32 docs; returned vectors ~120 ms server-side.
[03:25] Priya: Is that per-document latency or server-side?
[03:30] Liam: Server-side; network adds ~20-40 ms. Hosted multi-region; you can pin region.
[03:50] Sara: How charge embeddings?
[03:54] Maya: Usage-based per embedding unit; pricing sheet will be sent. Optimize suggests batching, caching, model variants.
[04:10] Liam: Rerank endpoint demo: accepts query and candidate snippets, returns scores + reordered list; optimized for cross-attention scoring, more expensive but higher relevance.
[05:05] Tom: Can we run rerank only on top-3 to save cost?
[05:10] Liam: Yes: recall top-K then rerank small set. Hybrid coarse filter then heavy rerank is common.
[05:35] Priya: Support custom training?
[05:40] Liam: Hosted uses curated open models; we accept labeled sets for model selection. Fine-tuning supported on Dedicated/Private.
[06:05] Sara: Data retention concerns for PHI.
[06:10] Maya: Options: hosted with strict retention, Dedicated/Private for full isolation. Will include SOC2 and residency docs.
[06:30] Liam: Hosted supports KMS integration and audit logs.
[06:45] Sara: Show Console Trace.
[06:50] Liam: Sample trace showing per-route latency, token counts, cost breakdown.
[07:20] Liam: Optimize recommends embedding dim tradeoffs, quantized rerank variant, batching windows, cache TTLs.
[07:55] Priya: Model fallback?
[08:00] Maya: Smart routing policies allow fallback to compatible variants or regions; set per-route policies.
[08:20] Sara: POC ask?
[08:24] Maya: Propose 1-week POC: sample dataset, relevance labels for subset, hosted eval with rerank, report (MRR, NDCG, latency, cost).
[08:40] Priya: SRE needs network egress and VPC options.
[08:46] Tom: Prefer private connectivity for PII.
[08:50] Liam: VPC peering or Private deployment for low-latency/PII. For hosted POC we can set retention=0 and remove logs.
[09:20] Demo deep-dive: query embedding, dot-product against stored vectors, rerank top-5.
[09:50] Liam: curl example: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank returns ordered list and scores.
[10:25] Liam: We have examples for ES vector fields, Pinecone, Redis AI.
[10:45] Liam: Console evaluation harness computes MRR, NDCG@k, precision, recall and per-query error analysis.
[11:40] Tom: SLOs for hosted?
[11:42] Maya: Publish p50/p90 token latencies per model; Dedicated offers SLA-backed targets. We'll share observed p95 for POC.
[12:08] Liam: Batch size guidance: embeddings batch 16-64; rerank small sets.
[13:05] Liam: You can blend lexical and reranker scores client-side or return raw logits for linear combo.
[13:35] Maya: Key rotation supported; scoped keys available.
[13:50] Liam: Optimize cost forecasting simulates per-call cost.
[14:25] Liam: Console experiments for variant A/B and compare NDCG. Canary and regression checks recommended.
[15:10] Maya: Recap: send pricing + benchmarks, send security whitepaper, Brightdale to provide queries/labels, kickoff 2/24.
[15:36] Liam: We accept arbitrary JSON docs; choose text fields to embed; metadata passthrough in rerank.
[16:03] Liam: Provide IP ranges and VPC peering support; hosted POC over TLS + mTLS if needed.
[16:23] Maya: Share sanitized healthcare references and compliance packages.
[17:10] Demo Optimize run suggests embedding dim 512, batching window 50 ms, cache doc embeddings.
[17:35] Liam: Cache TTL or event-driven invalidation recommended.
[17:44] Maya: Committed capacity available on Dedicated; recommend hosted for POC.
[18:05] Liam: Migration to Dedicated is mainly config; API remains same.
[18:28] Liam: Latency tips: reduce seq length, smaller embedding models, precompute doc embeddings, smart routing to nearest region.
[24:00] Liam: Evaluation report shows NDCG delta +0.12 and cost estimate; full numbers in pricing sheet.
[24:35] Priya: POC on subset first; larger evals available as paid engagement.
[25:10] Security micro-discussion: redactions, KMS, audit logs, retention=0, Private for PHI.
[26:05] Liam: For initial POC retention=0 and IP allowlist may be sufficient; Private/Dedicated for PII.
[27:15] Priya: Timeline: internal approvals ~2 weeks; POC next week if approvals happen.
[27:40] Wrap-up: Maya to email notes + links.
[54:00] Meeting ends.

Action items: see action_items field.

Shared links mentioned in conversation are referenced in the follow-up email and will be shared by Redwood.
